entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, this is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I need to start a return for a fitness tracker I purchased.
Okay, I can definitely help you with that. Can I get your order number, please?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered about 89 days ago. Let's see... yep, our policy states you have up to 90 days for a return.
Oh, great. I was worried I might have missed the window.
Nope, you're just in time. It's no problem at all. I can get that return started for you right now.
That's fantastic. What do I need to do?

I'm generating a prepaid return label for you as we speak. I'm emailing you the label and the instructions. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll issue the full refund.
Wow, that was easy. I just got the email. Thank you so much for your help!
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
